data.name: Khuder
data.gender_notes: Khuder is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Khuder is derived from the Arabic root 'kh-d-r', which means 'to serve'. It is a name that signifies devotion and submission to Allah. In the Quran, Allah says, 'And remember the favor of Allah upon you and His covenant with which He bound you when you said, 'We hear and we obey; [we seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final destination.' (7:286). Khuder is a name that embodies this spirit of obedience and submission to Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes servitude and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Khuder belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khuder total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
